notes.title: Postponement of Release & Demo Update
notes.content:
I was planning to sell this game in this year, but unfortunately, I could not do it in time, so I will postpone it until next year
We apologize for the inconvenience

The trial version has been updated. There is no new content, but the system of grabbing things, the movements of the insects, the appearance of the partner (only the tracksuit), etc. have been changed

notes.title: Apologize for the update not made
notes.content:
I announced an update before, but I checked and it was not updated
Now it has been updated correctly. I sincerely apologize
